evidence_excerpts: These humans move in a village modeled with 41,260 polygons. The display updates between 12 and 20 frames per second, depending on the displayed polygonal complexity.
The frame per second rate for 0 people was 26.20; for 1,000 people, it was 24.08; for 5,000 people, it was 18.26; and for 10,000 people, it was 13.35.
text: The tested system renders 10,000 different humans in a 41,260-polygon village at 12 to 20 frames per second, with measured frame rates falling from 26.20 fps at zero people to 13.35 fps at 10,000 people.
